# Far Fox

> Far Fox (lovefarfox.com) is a relationship app for long-distance couples. Both partners join one private space and build a daily connection ritual: daily questions, love letters, photo sharing, couple challenges, reunion countdowns, and a shared virtual fox that grows as the couple shows up for each other. It is free to start. The site also offers a free, no-signup couple quiz: each partner answers six questions about how they feel loved, then a side-by-side reveal shows where their love profiles match.
